payload.title: Improve a fixed example list across feedback rounds
payload.description:
## Purpose

Add a small, native, deterministic `improve_example_list()` driver that challenges the incumbent fixed list each feedback round and promotes only a clearly better one.

## Scope (design §3.2)

- List size k = 4 per label plus 1 reserve per label.
- **Development split per round:** the round's newest labels minus every item in any trial's list, capped at 100. Candidates: all other labels. Scoreboard IDs (e.g. dev-100, paper-600) go in `protected_ids` and are refused.
- **At most 3 trials per round:** (1) incumbent (zero-shot in round 1); (2) hard swap: replace ⌈k/2⌉ slots per label with the most confidently wrong out-of-fold labeled candidates (round 1: cached zero-shot errors), filling from `PrototypeBalanced`, dropping the most recently added slots first; (3) exploration `RandomBalanced(seed=round)` (round 1 also `PrototypeBalanced`).
- All trials run through `search_context_policies` as `FixedExampleList` policies, scored by Brier.
- **Promote** only if Brier improves by ≥ 0.005 and accuracy does not fall; ties go to the incumbent.
- Enforce a per-round request budget (`max_requests_per_round`, default 800) through `call_accounting`.
- Return search fingerprints, trials and objective for the bundle's `fewshot` audit. A frozen bundle never re-optimizes.
- Record, do not fix, the known bias that development items later enter head training.

## Definition of done

Fake-model specs first: incumbent keeps ties; protected IDs refused; promotion threshold honoured; deterministic for fixed seeds; budget ceiling stops the search; no network. `make test` green. Cost: $0 in core (live use happens in the evaluations harness).

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Improve a fixed example list across rounds
  Scenario: The incumbent keeps a tie
    Given an incumbent fixed list and a challenger with equal development Brier and accuracy
    When improve_example_list runs a round
    Then the incumbent is kept and every trial is recorded
  Scenario: Protected items cannot be used
    Given a protected scoreboard ID among the candidates
    When improve_example_list runs a round
    Then the round is refused before any model call
```

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §3 (all), §4.2 (`fewshot.optimizer` config), §6 step 2.
